finding.expected: Close the duplicate-authority path completely. P7.5 must not own or accept a decision deadline value on ValueOfInformationInquiry or ValueOfInformationPlan. Keep the canonical deadline only in P7.3 DecisionContext; P7.5 may bind to the exact context_id and carry bounded decision_deadline_consideration text explaining deadline effects. Remove the plan decision_deadline field/projection and any direct-construction acceptance of a second deadline. Add a focused regression with a DecisionContext containing a real deadline that proves the deadline remains solely on DecisionContext, the P7.5 plan binds to that context id, and both inquiry/plan reject any independent deadline value. Preserve all other P7.5 semantics, roadmap state, P7.3/P7.4 modules, and control-plane state.
finding.issue: The correction removes the independent inquiry datetime but moves the canonical deadline value into public ValueOfInformationPlan.decision_deadline. Because ValueOfInformationPlan remains directly constructible and exported, callers can still create a P7.5 plan with an arbitrary deadline that disagrees with the P7.3 DecisionContext. The factory copies the context deadline correctly, but the semantic type itself still accepts and validates an independent deadline value, so the duplicate-authority path remains open. The regression even constructs ValueOfInformationPlan with caller-supplied decision_deadline, confirming the second deadline authority still exists.
